chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Qasim al-Sayqal, who said:

I wrote to him: May I be made your ransom, did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام perform ghusl when he washed the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم at the time of his death? He replied: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم is pure and purified, but Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام did perform it, and the sunnah (prophetic tradition) came to be established by it.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the established prophetic tradition or normative practice
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام perform ghusl after washing the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith asks whether Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام performed ghusl after washing the body of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. The reply states that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم is pure and purified, yet Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام nevertheless performed ghusl, and this became the established sunnah (prophetic tradition).
